questions.examTip: Structure your description in three parts: what you see, an opinion, and a personal link — this shows range beyond simple description.
questions.modelAnswer:
Sur la photo, il y a un groupe d'adolescents qui jouent au foot dans un parc. Ils courent et ils ont l'air en pleine forme et contents. À mon avis, le sport est essentiel pour les jeunes parce qu'il aide à rester en bonne santé et à réduire le stress. Personnellement, je fais du sport deux fois par semaine et je me sens toujours mieux après.

(English translation: In the photo, there is a group of teenagers playing football in a park. They are running and they look very fit and happy. In my opinion, sport is essential for young people because it helps you stay healthy and reduce stress. Personally, I do sport twice a week and I always feel better afterwards.)

Useful phrases: ils ont l'air + adjective; il aide à + infinitive; je me sens mieux
questions.question: Describe this photo of teenagers playing football in a park on a sunny day. Say what they are doing, how they might be feeling, and give your opinion on the importance of sport for young people.

questions.examTip: Prepare flexible phrases for the unexpected question in advance; you cannot predict it exactly, but a stock structure (opinion + reason + example) will fit almost any topic.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Je pense que ma vie est assez saine, mais je ne dors pas toujours assez.
— Je devrais me coucher plus tôt pendant la semaine.
— (Question imprévue) Hier, j'ai mangé une salade au déjeuner et des pâtes avec des légumes au dîner.

(English translation: — I think my life is fairly healthy, but I don't always sleep enough.
— I should go to bed earlier during the week.
— (Unexpected question) Yesterday, I ate a salad for lunch and pasta with vegetables for dinner.)

Useful phrases: assez sain(e); je devrais + infinitive; j'ai mangé/j'ai bu

note.summary:
Healthy living and lifestyle
Key vocabulary
- équilibré
- éviter
- en bonne santé
- une matière grasse
- se sentir bien

Revision focus
Practise present, past and future forms while discussing healthy living, food, sport and wellbeing. Build answers with justified opinions and precise examples.

Exam technique
- Spot time markers and negatives before answering.
- Use parce que/car to justify an opinion.
- Check adjective agreement, verb endings and whether the task asks for French or English.
